item.title: Crown Lane SW16 between Knights Hill junction and, 19th September
item.description:
Crown Lane SW16 between Knights Hill junction and Leigham Court Road junction. From Knights Hill junction to the boundary of Fern Lodge Estate (to what could be streetlight ID number 18) is 30mph and then the rest to Leigham Court Road junction is 20mph. From my Freedom of Information request Lambeth ref: IRN44652995 dated 15 April 2026 you do not hold speed limit mapping information so you directed me to the Transport for London speed map which shows this as I describe above – go to: https://tfl.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/basic/index.html?appid=23ad4edbd905493089048e1bb3ea8da1 I have two issues for you to correct: a) For east bound traffic side of the road (ie north side) the streetlight at the speed boundary has 20mph signs on both sides. So the sign facing west bound traffic needs to be changed to a 30mph sign. Attached pictures show this. b) West bound traffic (is south side of road) there is no signage so you need to place a pole with a 20mph sign & a 30mph sign. I look forward to seeing the correct speed limit signage at this location.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Esam Way, West Norwood, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
